contract: Library media drawer Provider history: let a collection operator ask whether an existing BookOrbit identity may belong to a different canonical item in the same library, review the bounded evidence and blockers, and understand that the result is read-only. Keep the preview compact, quiet, and scannable inside the existing observation card. Never expose credentials, raw payloads, internal identity row IDs, or a mutation action. Support 390x844 and 1440x900 with long titles and both eligible and blocked candidates.

accessibility.evidence: Playwright opened the preview through the named Check identity match button and asserted visible candidate, evidence, blocker, and read-only text. Rendered inspection confirmed that confidence, eligibility, and blockers are expressed in text rather than color alone.

responsive.evidence: Rendered 390x844 and 1440x900 captures keep the provider observation, preview summary, evidence badges, candidate status, and drawer actions within the available width without horizontal overflow or overlap.

loading.evidence: The browser flow exercised the request transition while the action changed to Checking candidates… and remained disabled until the result returned.

empty.evidence: The browser regression switched the endpoint to no_candidates, requested the preview again, and asserted the explicit No same-library candidates matched this observation message.

error.evidence: The preview request uses the existing recoverable drawer error path: a failed request leaves the observation card intact, restores the action, and reports the failure through the application toast.

partial.evidence: The rendered preview includes one reviewable candidate and one blocked candidate, preserving both matching evidence and the explicit series-or-issue conflict.

success.evidence: The browser regression rendered and asserted a high-confidence eligible candidate, selected ComicVine and series/issue evidence, the candidate counts, and the explicit nothing has moved notice.

permission.reason: An out-of-scope media item or observation receives a non-disclosing not-found response before Provider history or the rematch preview can be rendered.

renderedEvidence.observation: Desktop drawer shows one reviewable and one blocked high-confidence candidate with distinct evidence, blocker text, read-only labeling, and the explicit no-mutation notice.
Mobile drawer keeps the long media title, provider observation, action, preview summary, first candidate evidence, and persistent drawer controls readable without overlap.
